text: Hi, I'm really sorry to bother you this late, I know you're probably busy with properly serious stuff. I'm 16 and I'm watching my little sister who's 5 because my mum's on a night shift and I can't get hold of her, her phone's in her locker. My sister felt really hot so I used the thermometer from the bathroom cupboard and it says 39.6. I did it twice to make sure. She's got a few insect bites on her arms from playing in the garden yesterday and she keeps scratching them, and her eczema has gone really bad again, the dry patches behind her knees and on her elbows are all rough and itchy and she won't stop going at them. I put her cream on but I don't know if I'm meant to do anything else. I don't really know if the temperature is high or normal for a kid, sorry if this is a stupid question. I just don't want to get it wrong while mum's not here. Sorry again and thank you.
